about: Country Condo's Limited is a Hyderabad-based real-estate company that procures land, develops residential plotted layouts and sells plots after registration; it also undertakes allied site-development work. Originally incorporated as Neocure Therapeutics Pvt Ltd in 1987, it diversified from pharmaceuticals and adopted the present name in December 2006. [1] [2]
